content.summary: An animated signal engineer drives a modular identity card with walks and interface rings. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: At least three adult identity anchors remain fixed. + Character motion motivates every graphic handoff. + One exact short word appears per module. + Graphic density may change without identity drift. + The final module restores the complete name and character.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one original adult animated signal engineer with silver braids, a navy utility coat and one amber badge under the exact name RHEA VALE. Use a shoulder turn to rotate one amber interface ring while face, braids, coat and badge remain registered. Seat the complete engineer inside the returning ring and hold the exact final title RHEA / LIVE.
required_anchors: At least three adult identity anchors remain fixed.
Character motion motivates every graphic handoff.
Graphic density may change without identity drift.
The final module restores the complete name and character.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An animated signal engineer drives a modular identity card with walks and interface rings. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
